amos.7.p1.b1.text: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts just after the king’s harvest, as the late spring crop was coming up.

amos.7.p1.b2.text: “Lord GOD, please forgive! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”

amos.7.p1.b4.text: “Lord GOD, please stop! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”

amos.7.p1.b8.text: “I am setting a plumb line among My people Israel; I will no longer spare them:

amos.7.p1.b9.text: The high places of Isaac will be deserted, and the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste;

amos.7.p2.b1.text: “Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words,

amos.7.p2.b2.text: for this is what Amos has said: ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’”

amos.7.p2.b3.text: “Go away, you seer! Flee to the land of Judah; earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.

amos.7.p2.b4.text: But never prophesy at Bethel again, because it is the sanctuary of the king and the temple of the kingdom.”

amos.7.p2.b5.text: “I was not a prophet,” … “nor was I the son of a prophet; rather, I was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees.

amos.7.p2.b6.text: But the LORD took me from following the flock and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to My people Israel.’

amos.7.p2.b7.text: Now, therefore, hear the word of the LORD. … Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘… Your land will be divided by a measuring line, and you yourself will die on pagan soil. And Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’”
